  (loop [words (str/split body #" ") line prefix n (count prefix) acc []]
    (if-let [w (first words)]
      (let [candidate (if (= line prefix) w (str line " " w))]
        (if (> (count candidate) width)
          (if (= line prefix)
            (recur (rest words) (str prefix w) (count (str prefix w)) acc)
            (recur words cont (count cont) (conj acc line)))
          (recur (rest words) candidate (count candidate) acc)))
      (if (seq line) (conj acc line) acc))))
(defn wrap-line [s]
  (let [t (str/trim s)]
    (if (or (<= (count s) 78)
            (str/starts-with? t "#")
            (str/starts-with? t "*")
            (str/starts-with? t "http")

      s

(defn wrap-words [body prefix cont width]
  (loop [words (str/split body #" ") line prefix n (count prefix) acc []]
    (if-let [w (first words)]
      (let [candidate (if (= line prefix) (str prefix w) (str line " " w))]
        (if (> (count candidate) width)
